access.connectDescription: This project uses the access and setup your organization manages in Fyso Biz. Connect to see your departments and the organization's setup.
access.connectStepSignIn: You sign in to Fyso Biz.
access.connectStepConsent: You approve access for this project.
access.connectStepPreview: You come back here and see a preview with a warning of what would change. Nothing changes until you confirm.
access.reauthorize: Your Fyso Biz connection predates departments and we cannot tell who you are. Reconnect Fyso Biz to see your departments; meanwhile nothing about your teams is changed.
access.departmentsIntro: The same ones you have in Fyso Biz. If they change there, they update here.
access.admin: You are an organization administrator: you have full access.
access.none: You are not in any department yet. Ask an administrator to add you in Fyso Biz.
access.noneAdmin: You are not in any department, but as an administrator you can use everything.

roleHint.lider: You can chat with the agents, run workflows and create bots.
roleHint.miembro: You can chat with the agents and run workflows. Creating bots here is up to a lead.
roleHint.lectura: You see what the agents do, without changing anything.
roleHint.custom: A tailored role defined in Fyso Biz.

access.policyNote: Your administrator sets this in Fyso Biz; it does not depend on your departments.

presetHint.cuidado: You use what you are given. Nothing to install and agents do not touch your machine.
presetHint.equilibrado: You install from the Fyso catalog and agents ask before changing anything on your machine.
presetHint.libre: You install what you want and agents work without asking.
presetHint.personalizado: A tailored setting from your administrator.

extensions: You install extensions from the Fyso catalog.
mcp_servers: You connect MCP servers from the catalog.
read: Agents do not read files on your machine.
Agents can read files on your machine.
write: Agents change nothing on your machine.
Agents ask before changing anything on your machine.
Agents change your machine without asking.
ai: You cannot use your own AI models.
You also use the most capable AI models.

setup.title: Organization setup
setup.intro: The setup your organization publishes in Fyso Biz (extensions, MCP servers, bots, secrets). It is kept up to date every 15 minutes.
setup.noAccess: You do not have access to the organization's setup yet. Ask an administrator to add you to a department in Fyso Biz.
setup.frozen: Your access was revoked: this project is read-only and the secrets delivered by the setup were removed.
setup.secretsPending: The setup's secrets are not encrypted for this installation's key yet, so they were not installed: {{names}}. They arrive automatically once the administrator publishes again.
setup.paused: Sync is paused: {{reason}}. Nothing was changed.
setup.connectedPublisher: Connected. Setup {{version}} published by this project.
setup.noneOffered: The organization has not published a setup yet; only its rules apply.
setup.nothingLost: Nothing local will be replaced or removed.
setup.warning: Applying the setup will replace and remove the items below. A snapshot is taken first; locally edited files are also saved as a patch in .data/dist.
setup.removed: Removed because the organization's policy does not allow them ({{count}})
setup.snapshotNote: Cancel to stay disconnected: nothing is changed.
